Projects with no plugin toolchain get an HTML `page` artifact. That is part of the live components decision I recorded as "option C", and the spec is `.design-foundations/plans/2026-10-16-live-components.md`.

My memory doesn't hold how option C was settled. I have no record of the alternatives or the owner's exact words, so the spec file is the place to check.

What I do know is how it shipped. Slice 1 landed in d9ede1e03 and 495066138, with `stage.ts`, `/@cawco/sheet` and `artifact_create(kind:"sheet")`. It supports Vite 6 and newer only, and Vite 5 is refused by name. A second code path for Vite 5 needs your go-ahead.
